name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.adjacent_chains_redundant
title: Adjacent thresholds make both eq chains redundant
statement: If I and J are order-convex sets of naturals (the Gray-rank intervals of the subtrees of the two chain prefixes at the level where the codewords of ranks t and t+1 first differ) with t in I, t+1 not in I, t+1 in J and t not in J, then every element of I is at most t and every element of J is at least t+1.
